R environment for the R scripts in this repository.
renv was never used for this project — no renv.lock exists. No package
versions were recorded at run time; none are invented below.

R version
---------
Thesis Methods state R 4.3.2.
Evidence from the source tree: OmnipathR logs (Chapter2_Figures/omnipathr-log/
omnipathr-20260605-1435.log) show the analysis machine ran R 4.4-arm64;
the installed Seurat/SeuratObject were built under R 4.4.3.
Treat the exact minor version as uncertain (logs and notebooks record mixed environments).

Seurat version used for demultiplexing
--------------------------------------
Recovered read-only on 2026-10-21 from a per-hashtag Seurat object written by
the demultiplexing script (bioinfo/sc_R/unfiltered/240316-Donor2-MoMac-Day1-MDI.rds,
2024-06-18): stored obj@version = SeuratObject 5.0.2. SeuratObject 5.0.2
accompanies Seurat 5.1.0, the version stated in Methods 7.1; consistent with
the thesis. Caveat: obj@version reflects the last Seurat version to touch the
object (e.g. via UpdateSeuratObject), not necessarily the one first used.

Packages named in the thesis
----------------------------
  DESeq2, Seurat, clusterProfiler, ComplexHeatmap, EnhancedVolcano,
  MuSiC, BayesPrism
  (BayesPrism: no corresponding code exists in this repository. MuSiC: used in
   02-chapter3-bulk-rnaseq/04_music_deconvolution.R.)

Packages actually loaded by the code in this repository
--------------------------------------------------------
From the scripts and the R console histories at source:
  DESeq2, apeglm, pheatmap, ComplexHeatmap, circlize, EnhancedVolcano,
  clusterProfiler, fgsea, enrichplot, org.Hs.eg.db, DOSE,
  dendextend, factoextra,
  ggplot2, dplyr, tidyr, readr, tibble, stringr, reshape2, tidyverse,
  RColorBrewer, scales,
  rstatix, ggpubr, patchwork,
  OmnipathR, decoupleR (R), edgeR, R.utils
Via rpy2 in 06_integration_benchmark.ipynb (R side): Seurat, dplyr, STACAS.

Additional packages loaded by the scripts added on 2026-10-21
(demultiplexing, pseudotime, MoMacVerse projection, deconvolution, Chapter 6):
  Seurat (v5 API: JoinLayers, IntegrateLayers, CCAIntegration), SeuratWrappers,
  SeuratDisk, SeuratData, scCustomize, Nebulosa,
  slingshot, monocle3, SingleCellExperiment,
  MuSiC, zellkonverter, CellDistinguisher,
  sceasy, reticulate, decontX (loaded but never called),
  edgeR, cowplot, ggbeeswarm, ggalt, ggforce, viridis, magrittr, patchwork,
  pheatmap, ComplexHeatmap, colorRamp2, RColorBrewer, scales, dplyr, ggplot2, tidyverse.
  (MuSiC is therefore both thesis-named and used; BayesPrism remains unused.)

Install with e.g.:
  BiocManager::install(c("DESeq2","apeglm","ComplexHeatmap","EnhancedVolcano",
    "clusterProfiler","fgsea","enrichplot","org.Hs.eg.db","DOSE","edgeR",
    "OmnipathR","decoupleR","BayesPrism","MuSiC"))
  install.packages(c("pheatmap","circlize","dendextend","factoextra","tidyverse",
    "reshape2","RColorBrewer","scales","rstatix","ggpubr","patchwork","R.utils",
    "Seurat","STACAS"))
